title: Will Trump's AI rebrand to 'super intelligence' catch on?
summary: Trump administration officials are testing the term 'super intelligence' as a rebrand for artificial intelligence. However, experts believe this terminology is unlikely to gain widespread adoption in the industry or media.
content: Some people close to the president have started to use the term but experts say it is unlikely to catch on.

zh.title: 特朗普将人工智能改名为"超级智能"能否流行？
zh.summary: 特朗普政府官员正在测试将人工智能改名为"超级智能"。然而，专家认为这个术语不太可能在业界和媒体中获得广泛采用。

title: In photos: Key takeaways from day one of the UN General Assembly
summary: World leaders gathered in New York for the annual UN General Assembly with discussions spanning geopolitical conflicts and emerging risks from artificial intelligence. The assembly brings together global representatives to address pressing international issues.
content: World leaders descended on New York for the annual United Nations General Assembly, where the agenda covers topics from wars to the risks posed by AI.

zh.title: 图片：联合国大会第一天的关键要点
zh.summary: 世界领导人聚集在纽约参加年度联合国大会，讨论包括地缘政治冲突和人工智能带来的新兴风险。大会汇聚全球代表以解决紧迫的国际问题。

title: South Korean solar stocks jump as curbs on Chinese sector expected to remain in place
summary: South Korean solar companies saw stock gains as U.S. trade restrictions on Chinese solar products remained in effect ahead of negotiations between the Trump and Xi administrations. The trade measures continue to benefit South Korean competitors in the market.
content: South Korean solar stocks jumped as U.S. restrictions on Chinese solar products came into focus ahead of the Trump-Xi summit.

zh.title: 随着对中国部门的限制预计将继续，韩国太阳能股票上升
zh.summary: 随着美国对中国太阳能产品的贸易限制在特朗普和习近平政府谈判前继续有效，韩国太阳能公司股票上升。这些贸易措施继续使韩国竞争对手受益。

title: Stock futures are little changed after Nasdaq Composite posts fresh record: Live updates
summary: The Nasdaq Composite reached a new all-time intraday high and closed at a record level on Tuesday. Futures trading showed minimal movement following the milestone.
content: The Nasdaq Composite rose to a new all-time intraday high and closed at a record on Tuesday.

zh.title: 纳斯达克综合指数创新高后股指期货基本持平：实时更新
zh.summary: 纳斯达克综合指数周二创造了新的日内历史高位，并以创纪录水平收盘。里程碑事件后，期货交易显示最小幅度的波动。

title: Oil falls after U.S. and Iran talk for hours at UN meeting
summary: Oil prices declined Wednesday following extended diplomatic talks between U.S. and Iranian officials at the United Nations. The discussions raised hopes for a potential peaceful resolution to Middle East tensions.
content: Oil fell Wednesday, amid hopes of a diplomatic solution to the conflict in the Middle East after Iran and the U.S. had talks.

zh.title: 美国与伊朗在联合国会议上进行数小时会谈后油价下跌
zh.summary: 周三，美国和伊朗官员在联合国进行了长时间的外交谈判后，油价下跌。这些讨论增加了人们对中东局势可能和平解决的希望。
